ModuleTitle.helper: Administrator-facing title for this module. This syncs with DNN module settings and does not display to visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page. Letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

EyebrowText.helper: Optional. Small label shown above the heading. HTML is allowed.

Heading.helper: Required. Main heading shown in the feature card. HTML is allowed.
Heading.placeholder: Connect the tools behind your workflow.

IntroText.helper: Required. Supporting copy shown below the heading. HTML is allowed.
IntroText.placeholder: Show the platforms, services, and systems that support a modern operational stack.

PrimaryButtonText.helper: Optional. Primary CTA text. The button only displays when text and link are both set.

PrimaryButtonOpenInNewWindow.helper: Open the primary CTA in a new browser tab.

SecondaryButtonText.helper: Optional. Secondary CTA text. The button only displays when text and link are both set.

SecondaryButtonOpenInNewWindow.helper: Open the secondary CTA in a new browser tab.

CenterIconClass.helper: Font Awesome class for the center icon. Used only when Center Image is empty.

CenterImage.helper: Optional. Image used instead of the center icon.

CenterIconColor.helper: Choose the center icon color when Center Image is empty.

OrbitItems.helper: Add orbit items in display order. Image takes priority over Icon Class. Angle is optional and should be a number from 0 to 359.

Label.helper: Required. Internal label and hover title for the item.

IconClass.helper: Optional. Font Awesome class. Used only when Image is empty.

Image.helper: Optional. Uploaded logo or icon image. Takes priority over Icon Class.

IconColor.helper: Choose the icon color when Image is empty.

OrbitNumber.helper: Choose which dotted orbit ring should contain this item.

Angle.helper: Optional. Custom starting angle in degrees, for example 45. Leave empty to auto-position by display order.
